name: Zond-4
about: Zond-4 (1968-013A, TSKBEM), launched 1968 Mar  2. Its phases from GCAT: G of Guinea. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
GCAT gives no landing site; the sub-point is a stand-in
